decisions.decision: render-html.cjs renderHtml MUST be self-contained (all helpers inlined) — JIT-extraction first attempt failed because Function() sandbox couldn't see cockpit-sidecar.cjs scope helpers

SAC accepts both POSIX graceful exit (code===0) and Windows signal-termination (signal==='SIGTERM') — child.kill('SIGTERM') maps to SIGKILL on Windows per Node child_process docs; handler can't run cross-platform
